text: Lili's has never disappointed with their food! My go to order is the crack chicken with two over easy eggs & kimchi rice. Soso good. The only reason for the poor review is because of my last experience with a to go order. I paid with card and signed the receipt. I did not leave a tip --when I do take out, sometimes I leave a few dollars, and sometimes I don't (I always tip when dining in though!). When I got to my car, I was looking over the receipt and noticed that an $8 tip was added to the total. Confused, I went back in and asked the cashier about the charge. She said that it looked like I wrote an 8... but I had drawn a line through the tip section AND wrote the total. She was quite rude about it, and tried to turn me away before she seemed to do anything on her end. She just said, "Okay. Got it." I asked if I would be refunded, and she angrily said that I would. It wasn't until then that she entered something into the computer. She said it was fixed and said I was good to go. This whole encounter made me very uncomfortable. Maybe it was a misunderstanding, but take this as a warning to double check your receipts!
Not bad. Meat was kinda dry but not awful. Went on an off hour, before dinner and after lunch so maybe they were short staffed.
Great service. Food not so much; Pretty average. Family friendly and good environment. Some nights they have live music (mariachi)

best place EVER! we go at least once a month. Manny the server is amazing, and David the manager is so funny! we always have a blast. AMAZING DRINKS AND FOOD! best place in town. we stay from 7 pm to last closing every time. non stop laughs, drinks, and great food!

Amazing! We love breakfast at the worker bee, but we needed a change after a few days in town. We ordered the sausage breakfast burrito and the chiliquelas. The spicy sauce was a great compliment to the meal. The patio dining area was super clean. Definitely worth your time if you are in Carpenteria.

Food incredible. Service excellent.  OH MY GOD IT IS WAY TO LOUD. THEY NEED TO GET NOISE ABATEMENT MATERIAL OR I WONT BE BACK. can't hear due to concrete floors, steel pillars, hardwood ceiling and loud background music and people noise.
Wonderful quality, unique venue (multiple local food Venus under one roof with shared seating), high quality products and decent prices. All in all a win.

I had never tried Caluda's so picked up a cream cheese one at a PJ's.  Got home and unwrapped to find a stale cake with hard as rock and off tasting cream cheese...it was disgusting.  threw the whole thing out.  Ill go back to Manny's and Antoines thank you.
Our go to place! Best crab rangoon I've ever had. We always get beef and broccoli, general tsos chicken, egg rolls and fried rice! We are always beyond pleased! Highly recommend!

Ordered several meals for take out just before Thanksgiving, Austin the bartender served us drinks and took our order. Great service and the food was excellent. You spend a little more , but worth it.

On my way to check into my hotel, I saw a long line outside of a restaurant about 4:30 pm.  Asked my hotel check in staff about the long line.  Was told the food is worth the wait and could be order as takeout.  Try to order online, but had some trouble.  Decided to order in person.  Normally they don't take walk-in order, but since I had problem with online order, my order was placed at store.  I am glad I did order the food, because it is the best chicken I ever had.  Great seasoning, very juice and tender.  Consistent every bite.  Besides the chicken, they also have great Potatoes salad and Mac and cheese.  I would definitely come back the next time I am in Nashville.
The specialty gruts were woth it. Cinnamon pecan grits were so good.  The french toast was perfect.

I have never left a yelp review before, but felt so inclined tonight. I have frequented Vinnie's for years.  Today I called at 730 and was told I am an inconvenience for ordering with a half hour left of service.  I told her that her hospitality was terrible and she laughed at me.  I will no longer be patronizing Vinnie's.  Unbelievable.

Great food! Great service! Great time! 

I had the jalapeno burger, which was amazing. I also had a side of fried pickles which were delicious as well. My friends had the BBQ burger and sweet potato fries. Who knew apple butter went so well with fries? Expecetional combo! 

Ground definitely gained some ground with me! I will be back for more :)

I WANT to like this place!  I've tried three times.  From watching the staff have a screaming match last time to having horrible service last Friday I can say never again.  I had to request twice to have our table bussed due to empty glasses and appetizer plates that weren't removed. I also had to track down the waiter to ask for water twice.  If I was at a Beef O'Brady's I might get it.  However, I've never had this problem at Beef's.  For the price here we NEVER should have had this experience.

Okay, I've got to be totally honest. My hubby is from New Orleans, and years ago he brought me here for the first time. My impressions then, remain my impressions now. This place looks horrible. The entire business is the size of a shoe box. The staff is rude, and inattentive. Everyone who works her appears to feel that they are doing you a favor, by taking your money. It's insane. But, they have some of the best fried rice you'll ever find. And they are usually very busy. I'd recommend the combination rice, and that you do take out!

My wife and I were anxious to try this new restaurant, and I'm happy to say it was exceptional. We had the lamb in curry sauce and salmon baked in banana leaf. Both were delicious. The naan was hot and flakey and tasty as well.  This is not the usual tikka masala fare you get in most Indian restaurants. The staff was very attentive and seemed genuinely interested in seeing that we had a good experience. The meal was memorable and not at all unreasonably priced. (Did I mention the watermelon spritzer? A cool drink for a hot summer evening.) And no, I'm not related to the owners or have a financial stake in this restaurant. I'm just an East Nashville resident who wants this place to succeed so that I can keep coming back to enjoy it!

A bustling, 24-hour diner, Daisy Duke's serves breakfast and (Cajun) dinner options all day. As someone from Cajun Country, I'm going to put it out there, I'm not always super impressed with New Orleans' cajun eateries...but Daisy Duke's is pretty solid. We started with crawfish hushpuppies which had a very creamy inside and the crawfish tails and flavor were very present. I had a cup of jambalaya and a cup of gumbo. The gumbo was a little too dark but was easily remedied with a dash of salt and hot sauce. The jambalaya, I only wish more peppers and tomatoes were present but it was still really yummy with tons of chicken, shrimp and sausage in every bite! They use really great quality shrimp, they were so big and succulent! Service was great too, everything came out in a timely manner and payment was processed quickly!

I love this place. I would say though if there is one thing I could change it would be the bacon egg and cheese Kolache cause it literally has nooo flavor!!! But my favorite of them all is the pepperoni one so if you need flavor get that one.   HINT: make sure to request to heat them up or else they won't do it most of the time.

Grimaldi's was fantastic great service the food is delicious all covid rules are followed the hostess Emma and Joana were awesome and so were the servers Katie and Sara!!! We will be happy coming here for a long time.

I've eaten at gyu in many other cities so I was pretty stoked when I heard they were coming to New Orleans.

We ordered an assortment of the popular meats, wings, spicy cucumber, and salad. The meats are always marinated with wonderful flavors. The only one that I didn't care for was the cube steak. A little on the harder side. All in all, I've never had a bad experience at gyu before and coming here, still received A1 service! Our waitress changed the grill once it got a little burnt.

This was my first time trying their fried cheese cake ice cream and OMG..it was delicious!  Liked it more than the green tea crepe cake, tbh.
My family and I decided to try this place on a whim. Turns out the food is great, good portions, good prices, and good service!

This place is quite a hole in the wall type of of place. There is barely any seating available and I did came in on a whim for a quick eat. I had the temptation roll and it was quite big and large for the price! They also have a pick 3 on simple rolls here deal for 10.99 that is really cheap. I would say the quality of fish is okay, but you do get what you pay for. I would probably come back for the pick 3, but not any of the special rolls since they are quite basic too despite the amount you get.
Tried for the first time this past weekend, great ambiance and staff. The lobster queso dip is exceptionally delicious, maybe best dip I've ever had?! Cant wait to try other things from here

Was very disappointed, expected everything to be top notch since prices were on the high end but it was far from being good. I would rate the food just average , overly priced . Flavors too strong, got the chicken biryani , which did not come with raita , too much raw ginger flavor , whole family ended up getting sick . Got the Chettinad chicken , highly disappointed, as it was more like some kind of rasam with pieces of chicken dumped in. Lacked the flavor or the true meaning of the dish. Save ur pocket book and try something cheaper when food would be way better.

Tipsy Cafe took over the space that Ham occupied at 3131 Walnut st,  I ordered the soft shell crab for lunch and i have to say if you're ever in the neighborhood do yourself a favor stop in and try them. Also, the salads are very good.

My husband and I were so excited to try this restaurant. Unfortunately, it did not meet our standards. I had the chicken enchiladas and they came out cold like they were sitting for awhile. My husband had the chicken quesidillas and were very dry. So not sure we will be back the atmosphere is great and the red sangria was awesome.

Been wanting to try out this place for awhile and finally did! It is a small little unassuming house across the street from the Mercado, with a small side parking lot. We ordered takeout due to Covid times and the ordering process was quick and easy. They finished a bit before the time reported which was a plus! Its a small mom and pop's shop serving full pizza pies as well as slices. Also with common italian pasta dishes. We ordered a pepperoni pizza (it came sliced into squares) and a chicken parmigiana with side of their market salad. Everything was great and at a reasonable price. The tomato sauce on the pizza is mildly spicy which I loved! And the chicken parm was cripsy fried goodness over a bed of pasta with a side of bread. Would definitely recommend Los Olivos for a low-key dinner night with these classic dishes!

Always friendly and fast.
I have done both drive through and ordering via app during COVID both worked well.
Everyone wears a mask.
Food is always consistent ,except last few times the coke was bad, unusual for Chick fil a.

Love this place!!! The food is amazing as well as the service!! I didn't know I loved Korean food until I found Arario! The bar has items you can't find anywhere else in Reno. I highly recommend Arario!

The baba is spectacular and the grape leaves were great. My wife had a kafta platter and she raved about the grilled veg that came with. I had  lamb schwarma and it was delightful. Very efficient and very clean. We will definitely return  BUT request a lemon wedge to get the hummus exactly like we want it. Boy, we are glad that Damas Grill came into our area. Made a take out tonight. Cant find any faults!  Had baklava tonight and it was delightfully tasty.
Terrible service, wait staff so slow, never around, and masks were down around necks, even when they were taking orders or serving food.  Ok food.  Kinda run down and smelly

I got the Espresso Chip ice cream & the Sweet and Salty cookie dough and this cup was just $5. The A/C blasts and the tastes of the ice cream and the cookie dough is perfect. I would definitely come again!

This place had the highest rating in this area full of hotels. It has a "general store" with nicknacks and candy and then the restaurant. 

The food was really yummy. Comfort food for sure so not flavour city but the chicken was cooked perfectly, the portions were huge and it was fun to try these dumplins. 

They were basically made of egg, flour and salt and then covered in chicken gravy. So great for a -21 night haha. 

Really extensive menu and breakfast is served all day. Our server was not at all helpful. It seemed like she hated our job. She dropped off the check at one point but no one noticed then when we asked for it she was a rude about how it had been there forever. We quickly got a card out and it took another 15-20 minutes for her to come over and tell us we have to pay at the front. Would have been great for her to mention it when she dropped the bill. It's an area full of airport hotels...I imagine most people are from around here.

I use to love this restaurant. Up until a few years ago. They let anyone with in the kitchen. Our food was cold when we got it. Didn't taste fresh at all on our lunch visit. I was highly disappointed and they are pretty expensive. The really should find cooks that take pride in what goes out on their shift! Great menu. Just need kitchen improvement

If I was sitting on my death bed and could have one last meal before I died, it would be a 12 piece wings (lemon pepper - dry rub) with a side of Cajun fries. I've had a lot of great wings in my life time but these wings were something else. My first bite into the wing I got cold chills from just how good they were. If I could recommend one place to eat in the state of Tennessee it would be Brother Z's Wangs. I honestly feel a little more alive after tasting those wings. - John J

This place is a hidden gem for relatively authentic Chinese food near downtown. They also have Americanized choices, sushi, bento box, and bubble tea. We usually got there for Chinese food which is on a separate menu. If you're familiar with family-style Chinese food, this is the right place to try it. A large portion, delicious food, and reasonably priced.

I forgot how good yummy house was. We had the dumplings, salt and pepper calamari, Hong king wonton soup, house fried rice, and Mongolian beef. Nothing bad on the table. Even my picky nephew had more than one favorites. Will try to go back soon as the family style try a bunch for not too much is one of my favorite aspects of the place. Nice staff and pretty Devore at this location.

Came to this place because of all the hype surrounding it! As someone who is South Indian, the food was pretty good here. We split a bunch of things - the vegetarian thali, Mysore masala dosa, and the chicken tikka. The Mysore masala dosa was definitely the best - very spicy, crisp edges, and delicious potato filling inside. The chicken tikka was very average.

The worst part about this place is the service. We waited almost 30 minutes for a waiter to even come to our table to give us water. We had also ordered chai drinks, which they ended up forgetting about and brought when we were almost finished our meals. Everything is very slow paced at this restaurant - if you're coming, be prepared to spend at least 1.5-2 hours.

Okay, we all know there are a plethora of great burger joints in the Nashville area. But Hopdoddy definitely serves up some up the best burgers around. Local ingredients are the culprit and you can really taste the difference when you take that first, glorious bite. 

This would be a 5-star experience for me but I don't really enjoy the experience of physically being at Hopdoddy. You wait in a line and have to give your order to the person at the register, but there are so many options here (impossible or homemade veggie or beef patty on which burger, what temp do you want it cooked to, with what toppings, pickles? dill or bread and butter pickles, which sides, which sauces, etc.) that it makes it difficult to get everything across at the counter. It would be easier if it were a regular sit down restaurant where I could point to all of my options on a menu in front of my face. The person at the till is always seemingly unhappy and irritated (don't really blame them--if I had to ask that many questions all day and have patrons think for a while before each answer, I'd be ready for a drink, too). Then they have to just look?....across the entire restaurant to find an open table, see the number, and then hand you the corresponding number. Then you have to figure out which table they're pointing to/looking at and find it yourself. I'm not sure if that's how the system is supposed to work, but that's how it's been the few times I've been there.

When you finally get your food (it'

I love the old library aesthetic. It has a very nice and peaceful atmosphere. The barista there is so nice. Any college students that want to come here this is a great study place. I definitely recommend the food there.

Yummy and affordable this place has tacos in a variety of flavors. The Baja fish comes either grilled or battered and fried. The carne Asada was nothing special but solid for what it is. The mango shrimp was sweet and savory. Even as an adult I was able to order from the kids menu, and the cheese quesadilla definitely hit the spot. I'm not sure I would recommend this place if you're super hungry but if you're looking for a place to hang out and get some munchies, it's got a good vibe and a good selection of craft beers.

I was feeling super below the weather and a friend recommended I try pho for the 1st time. When I got my order I was very confused and overwhelmed. But my friend took me under his wing and upon mixing all of the neatly manicured vegetables my sore throat was relieved :) Felt like some Desi home remedies no lie.

Some Einstein from corporate needs to come in and fire some ass.  Or close this location down. My experience here was so bad, it's a one and done for me.  I will NEVER go back. Waiting ten minutes for a bagel and cream cheese is bad enough. Having the bag thrust at me with an angry puss because I (politely) asked why it was taking so long is the coup de gras. Bagels with an attitude.  It doesn't take an Einstein to figure it out this place should be on your avoid list.  Just check their Yelp score.  I should've.

We had the Garbage Can ice cream and the Caramel. It was very creamy and delicious. The Garbage can ice cream is made with Vanilla ice cream and 7 different candy bars. My husband had the Banana Split which was a nice size portion. The line was out the door and almost to the street when we left. This place makes all the ice cream and everything on the premises. We were only visiting but I definitely recommend it.

Loved the friendly customer service, clean facility and most of all ... the pizza is WOW!  I'm picky about the crust, I don't like it spongy or too thick ... they make it just the way I like it.  Also loved the pizza sauce. I bought a large slice and a drink - both for only $7.  I'll definitely be back for this deal!
We went during peaked times with no reservation & were sitted quickly. Food was pretty good will eat there again!

Had a good time visiting this location for the first time.   What made the visit extra pleasant was our waitress  Ricki. She provided multiple recommendations on Wings, beer , and even a quick opinion on a new haircut.  Lol.   It's nice when a place has a great staff.

The food is always great. However, the last time we went to sit outside, we were told to wait 15 minutes then when we went to check in, they told us to sit anywhere available. We sat and waited for a server for over 15 minutes but no one came to greet us or take our orders until my husband went and told them!

Came for breakfast on a Saturday.  We ordered the chicken and waffles and a simple breakfast platter (eggs/potatoes/sausage).  Firstly, the service was good; the waitress was kind and informative.  The chicken and waffles were huge.  The chicken was crispy and the waffles had bacon in them.  The portions are very generous here.  2dishes could easily feed 3 people or 4 tiny humans.  Make sure you come hungry hungry.

Annoyed. I ordered salmon fried rice, crab fries and a dessert. However, I received fries with old bay instead. When I arrived, I was told "oh give us 15 mins" . Word of advice: Lower the music, adapt another system for taking phone orders or don't take phone orders at all.
We sat outside and really enjoyed the view.  Sara was our server and she was AWESOME!!!  The food is always good there, never had a bad meal or bad service.

We loved this place so much we went two nights in a row. Together our family had tortas, burritos, tacos, nachos and a quesadilla-- all of it was excellent and delicious. The tortilla chips were amazing the best we've had. Now if only they'd open a branch back home in New Jersey!

I've updated my review to 1 star from 3 due to the condescending, unapologetic email I received in response to our experience and now will most certainly never go back. The meal we had tasted good and came out quickly. Outside of that, the service was terrible, one of our desserts was stale, and they don't use buttercream frosting on their "buttercream frosting" cakes. According to the ridiculous email I was sent, it's a "Swiss Meringue Buttercream" which translates IMHO "no flavor". I made reservations for my birthday and they seated us outside in the 85 degree heat with 90% humidity instead of comfortably inside the air conditioning where there were plenty of open tables. We had to ask for silverware more than once just to be able to eat the meal that came out. We had to ask for a box 3 separate times before it was brought out, and more water at least twice. The food was good - we had the croque monsieur, lemon Parmesan chicken and pomme frites. They were out of the majority of their desserts and cakes I wanted to try, which is ridiculous on a weekend evening. And the ones we did try were way overpriced for what was served. The confetti cake was awful. I'm not sure where they learned to make buttercream frosting, but it had the flavor and texture of whipped topping icing and the cake was dry...as if it were a few days old. My husband had a cookie bar that also tasted like it was stale or a few days old. For $100 (without alcohol), I'd rather just eat someplace else in the f

We stopped yesterday for breakfast, very good as usual. Got 2 pieces of carrot cake to; had it for desert tonight but it was not the same, not as delicious as usual, called back and found out they switched vendors. The young man that spoke with me took my comments and said he would let the owner know. Sure hope that they go back to the original vendor as their cake was fantastic!! Thank you

This was the best Jersey Mike's I've had! They just made my Italian so great! The staff was just super nice too - I had a birthday coupon from last year that expired the next day, and they honored it  So note, this location doesn't accept regular Jersey Mike's coupons, I guess? But it was so so so nice that they still gave me my free sandwich and drink - thank you!!

It's been our tradition to have Asian food on New Year's Eve, but new to the area we weren't sure where to try for carry out.  In a normal year we would already have tried several places, but 2020 was anything but normal.  We did ask neighbors for recommendations and they all suggested a place that was at LEAST an hour round trip, which wasn't appealing.  We are so glad we didn't do that, as it's hard to believe the selection, food, and service could have been better than Liang's Bistro!  We selected coconut shrimp as the appetizer, as well as entrees of beef, chicken, and pork, along with vegetable fried rice.  Cameron answered and repeated the order back exactly right.  I arrived to pick it up about 5 minutes before he said it would be ready.  It was being packaged as I arrived.  The total was exactly as he stated.  Of course that shouldn't be an issue, but it seems to happen so again, nice work Cameron.

When I walked through the door the place smelled just wonderful.  The voices all seemed calm and organized though it was obviously busy in the kitchen.  I only saw 1 couple dining there, but the place is charming and when the worst of Covid passes, I definitely intend to return to dine in.  

When I unpackaged our order each item was in nice a container, no leaks or mess outside the containers.  Everything was still warm to eat without reheating.  We smiled at the couple extra fortune cookies beyond one per meal, a nice touch.  The items we ordered were beautifully prepare

Best service we have ever received! Tony's made our  anniversary special right from the moment we walked in. They take your coat and put your napkin on your lap. We had 4 men at our service the whole night. The attention to detail was wonderful. Our steaks were perfectly cooked and the sauce was amazing. They were so kind to give us a piece of cake aat the end, which we did not have  room for but ate anyways. Loved this  place and recommend to everyone. Classy, clean and delicious. We are going back for sure.

Megan was our server and she is so delightful!  We had bbq pulled pork nachos, salmon dip with pita bread and cheese shrimp for appetizers and half of rack of ribs plate, 2 catfish dinners and a Cajun pasta!  All the meals had sides and very, VERY delicious!
I would highly recommend the restaurant not only do you get a very decent helping of food but it is very tasty and be much like home cooked food.  The staff was wand the restaurant is clean.  ( yes bathroom too)
We will be back for the prim rib.  I suggest that if you want prime rib that you come early because they run out fast so I'm sure it's good.
I love the breakfasts and coffee! I enjoyed the waffles and eggs and bacon a few days ago!  Super friendly and great customer service!

*this is the second time this has happened* 

The pizzas here are floppy as a noodle and greasy as all get out. I have been here 3 times ( it's walking distance from my house).  First time I order revalue, second two times I ask for crispy. Here are the results. 

I ordered two slices of pizza to go. They put one pizza on the bottom, then that paper on top, then another slice. Their pizza is so greasy that it pulls off all the cheese and all the pepperoni from the pizza into the paper. Very irritating. On top of that, both my pizzas were burnt. There is a huge difference between crispy and burnt, and a pizza play should be able to do crispy. Never been somewhere that had this issue consistently. Real bummer because I would eat here multiple times a week due to the proximity to my home, but likely will need to find a new pizza place.

Worst place in the state.... food was awful came out cold...manager was a jerk...would not recommend to anyone..... brought appetizers and dinners out together .... and it was all cold on cold plates...who does that??? Awful!!!!!

I have been through what feels like too many menu changes and chef changes here over the years. But I do always find a gem on the menu that delights. Small neighborhood restaurant, on the more elegant side. Local at its best. Reservations are a must on the weekends. It is a relatively intimate space. Everyone knows everyone, but yet you can have a quiet romantic time as well. Great mixed drinks. Extensive, award-winning wine list. Super easy FREE parking. Attentive and friendly service. The cuisine is elevated, and the daily specials are quite special. But don't turn your nose up at getting a burger here... one of my favorites in the city! We always order one to go at the end of our meal... and we say it is for the next day. But the truth is, it never makes it through the night!

Adorable outdoor dining with really powerful heaters for each table. Their options are great for vegetarians and meat eaters - the Dan Dan wirh mushrooms are fantastic but their Brussel sprouts are to die for! They also have a great assortment of cocktails - the hot toddy they have on special right now is my favorite.

Come here on an empty stomach and you will definitely be leaving chicken full! Ordered take out and tried the rule-breaker: Chicken was great and went well with the jumbo shrimp. My bf ordered the chicken club sandwich which was also amazing for a great lunch.. spared half of it for leftovers. Garlic Parmesan fries are loaded with cheese but wish I tasted some more of the garlic. I've also tried their bulgogi cheesesteak on a separate occasion and it's definitely my favorite from their menu thus far.

Horrible organization!!!!
They did not tell me there was two valet first 3 days walked miles to and from the front valet. They messed up reservations on my second room. No maid service at all for 2nd room. Valet text to bring car up did not work. Calling front desk takes 1/2 hour. Room was nice property was nice. The employees just did not know what they are doing.
Great sandwiches and salads for lunch. The bread is fantastic. Breakfast sandwich and coffee is wonderful too. Pastries look great but haven't tried them yet. Outdoor seating option.

I have not eaten at Remedy, so this review is just for atmosphere, service, and drinks.

I am always glad when a new spot opens on the beautiful Hillsborough River.  Remedy is in the perfect location, right at the top of Curtis Hixon Park.  You can see across the water to UT and it has a nice view of most of downtown Tampa.  I recommend visiting in evening around sunset as that is when you will get the best view.

The drink menu is pretty standard for a nicer cocktail spot:  craft beers, mid priced wines, and some fancy liquor drinks.  On my visit, the service was good and the bartenders were quite attentive.  This is a great spot for some date night drinks with an excellent view.

Cajun style Denny's.

Crab cake Benedict - cakes were full of extenders and so pasty, Hollandaise tasted like it came from a box. 

Jambalaya - soupy rice. So badly prepared and seasoned. Farrrrr from what a jambalaya should be. 

Shrimp and grits - shrimp and grits were flavorless. Grits and shrimp were not at all seasoned. Yey for store bought andoullie sausage I guess?

Fried chicken - the only thing that was ok. 

Walked out disappointed and a $85 bill. Now searching for breakfast #2.

I highly recommend this location to anyone looking for great pizza and excellent employees . I had a problem with my doordash delivery, the delivery driver failed to collect my pizza from this location and left my pizzas sitting at this location for over two hours.  

I ended up having to go to this location to collect my pizzas. Jonathan and Monet (employees at this location) and their manager were awesome about the situation. They were understanding and their excellent customer service was very much appreciated.

I can't thank them enough. This location and pizza is fantastic!!!!!!!

We have been to TF several times both for Dinner and for Happy Hour and have overall been happy with their food and service. 
One of their policies is that they would not give you separate checks.  This creates a very awkward situation. We were there with 2 other couples and they refused to provide us with separate checks. (I know we could have just split the check 3 ways, but our amount varied significantly from one couple to another). When the bill came each couple had to tell the server the $ amount with the tax to charge on each card. Sounds ridiculous. Ruins the experience. We have never seen a restaurant do this. 
Hope the owner or manager reads this and changes their practice.  Hope they realize that they are losing business because they do not want to make a little more effort to provide great experience.

I've never been to this velvet cactus before February but I've been to the one in Baton Rouge - glad to know the place is similar in both areas. I love velvet cactus and especially their margaritas! 

When I came to this one in February, I was DD-ing my best friend for her bachelorette dinner and the service was pretty good - no complaints really. It was a particularly cold night so we were super happy that they provide blankets for you when you're there and have the heater stands around us. 

Trying to eat right at the time, I got the loaded cauliflower nachos. A little underwhelming to be honest, but they tried! I love nachos and missed having it on a low carb diet so I tested it out. Wished that I had gotten something more delicious but again, I can't complain because they do provide a low carb option, which not a lot of places like that do. It's a little out of the way for me but I definitely love coming here when I can.
Absolutely mw wife's favorite Florida restaurant. Lobster bisque is a must.

The food was great, and our server was incredible,  unfortunately the restrictions for COVID were only enforced for some patrons.  Had a table of 6 seated close enough that I could reach over and touch them had I chosen to (a little over 3ft). The first group of 6 that had been seated there must've felt the same way were did because they asked to be seated somewhere else after sitting down and looking at how close they were to everyone that was already there.   Then a second group was seated at the same table 3 feet away from ours moments later without the least bit of cleaning having been done.  Some of the patrons were also walking around from table to table without masks visiting with people they knew including the table 3ft from ours.  At one point they had wedged themselves between our table and the one they were visiting.  This would've been an issue under normal circumstances but now just seems even more ridiculous.  Our server took notice of everything and even asked once for the people to  move away from the other tables and return to their original table but was ignored.  She offered to bring the manager to handle it and speak with us but when she informed the manager he walked into the dining area, saw what was going on and just sat down at a table on the other side of the room,  never addressing the customer wandering through the dining area without a face covering touching anything he walked past.  When my family member asked a second time to voice his concern to

Awe I was so disappointed......I use to come here years ago.i remember how perfect their fries were and the cheese steak had just been a bonus. 

I recent went and the freshly cut fried that I remember them being crispy and cooked to perfection, they are no longer like that. I feel like the fires are okay every basic and the subs are a mess. 

Maybe it was just a bad day for them, but I was disappointed:(

Stopped here after a trip to the Magic House, and got a salad with carne asada, fajita veggies, and guacamole. The service was not great. Somehow, they started my family's order, then another family's, then back to ours. So it was really confusing at checkout. The food was alright, though the meat wasn't hot or plentiful enough. The location is too small, as well. I think the listed maximum capacity was 35, and by the lunch rush, we definitely were over. All and all, a pretty ho-hum experience.

I'm updating my review. I know the wait is usually really long so the past few times I've ordered my food and picked it up to go. This basically solved all my problems with this place since I get very hangry sitting and waiting for my food and watching other people eat.

Since they take in phone orders, I've grown to really love this place. The phone orders usually take 30-45 minutes. The quality and portions are still really good in the to-go orders. 

One big thing to note is that if you can't handle spicy, do not even think about going more than a level 1.

I have lived in Saint Pete for over 40 years and for the past couple of years of this is hands-down one of the top three places in Saint Pete to have lunch, and one of the top two places to have a Cuban sandwich. The line can be long but the food is well worth the wait and there are many cool businesses in the area you can check out while there.
Overcooked strip. Sent back and came back worse than before. Tried to charge us for second steak. Total fail. Will not return.

This is some of the best pizza in town!! The bar is neat too! I like the desano. This is a great place to eat or take out. 

It has a more relaxed vibe and would be good for kids too. You order at the counter.
BBQ was amazing! they staff was super friendly, and the food was exceptional! Deff loved the baked beans!

As a dude who thinks sushi should mean a crapload of raw fish...this ain't that kinda joint. 
There's interesting rolls and whatnot, but it's hard to get what I expect for sushi here. Tons of rice, not a lot of raw anything, and flavors that are all over the place. Not to mention the owner told me he flew the fish in from Japan....I mean oooook. 

Not a place I need to return to.

Located 10 minutes from the city center of Indianapolis, Siam Square is a solid choice for Thai food. Portions are typical of most Thai places; they are nice and big and enough to share or enough for a very hungry person. We ordered tom yum soup, crab rangoon, chicken satay, and 4 entrees and had about half the entrees left. All of the food was spiced very well and you can pick from different spice levels to determine how spicy you want your food. Our waitress was extremely nice and helpful. We changed our mind several times and she did not act irritated at all; she split our bill in a unique way that we asked of her and she had no problem with that either. No recommendation was needed on a week night but I am not sure about a weekend. Street parking seemed to be available. Overall, I enjoyed the food here and it was a nice place to go to before/after getting a drink at the tiki bar right next to it.

The food here was absolutely amazing! Husband had steak and eggs and his ribeye was seasoned better than most steakhouse steaks! We had a table covered with bacon cooked perfectly, crispy toast and and my southwest omelette was awesome. The pancakes tasted heavenly! Wish we lived closer because this would be a place we would frequent.

We got our weekly takeout from here on Saturday night. We called to order our takeout and the process was very easy. We even ordered a half pitcher of sangria! The staff was very nice and helped me carry my takeout out of the car. The dining room is open and they had a few diners inside. Staff was wearing masks and keeping everyone safe (thank you!) Everything was packaged considerately and tasted delicious! We ordered the ceviche, chorizo in sherry, lamb cops, garlic shrimp, garlic toast with Serrano ham and manchego, and brussel sprouts. The brussel sprouts were a little mushy, but everything else was delicious! The ceviche was incredible and the sangria was delicious! We can't wait to dine in person!

We wanted breakfast, so we ordered here. 

The restaurant was clean, friendly employees and nice guests. Social distancing is a must and you must wear your face mask. 

I don't eat breakfast meat, so I ordered a mushroom omelette, grits and potatoes. My son ordered French toast, bacon, sausage and scrambled eggs. My Husband, my daughter and her boyfriend had corn beef hash, grits and eggs. They were supposed to get biscuits, but didn't get any. 

The food was delicious and we will be back again.

I am updating my review because I visited there in July and my credit card was charged twice for the same bill. I have been trying to get it credited back to my account with no luck. Called 3 times and emailed. Either no response or promises to fix it and it hasn't happened. That is poor customer service imo

So disappointed we've never had a bad experience at a steak and shake until today 
.our fries were cold we didn't eat them ..my bun was hard took it off and the service wasn't at all friendly .the guy at the window was rude..the pop was great tho but I def would NOT recommend coming to this one .
Best Chilaquiles I ever had. Definitely home made red Chile sauce on it. It looked fast foodish to me at first but don't let that dissuade you.

Randomly found this spot one day while hunting for some Mediterranean food. One of the most authentic tasting places I've been to, incredibly tasty and great value. Not to mention the owner is a cool dude.

Four Sons is pure magic. Aside from having some of the best thin-crust pizza in the city, they are really involved in the community and give back!

So let's stick to the food: fresh and delicious, every time. I've had their pizza and salads, and friends have had the hoagies. All of their ingredients are great quality. The salads are fresh, loaded with toppings, and come with some yummy garlic bread. The Italian hoagie my husband ordered was HUGE and loaded with meats and cheeses - exactly what you want in an Italian hoagie.

Last, but not least: the pizza. They have a gorgeously large rotating pizza oven, with pies made fresh to order (as well as having slices). The crust is magically thin and chewy, without being too crispy or soggy. They have decent sauce, and use excellent mozz to top. 

And let's talk service... after a Grubhub ordering snaffu where the delivery driver couldn't find our address (??) and then just disappeared.... Four Sons remade our order rush, we went in to pick it up, and they even gave me a slice on the house for our trouble.

This is definitely a good choice if your craving some Cuban food for lunch. One of my favorite Cuban sandwich's in the Tampa area, I've ordered it a few times now. I prefer the Tampa Cuban as it has salami, and gives it a good little twist. 

The other sandwich ordered was the ropa veja sandwich (no I didn't eat both, me and my GF split them). This sandwich was different, but in a good way. It was sweet and odd, had meat, plantains, and cheese. Like I said an odd mixture but extremely satisfying. Would defiantly give this sandwich another try, but not over the Cuban 

A couple side orders of empanadas, and cro-K-tas are a must for me at any Cuban food establishment. I went with the spinach empanada this time, it was very tasty, good breaking and stuffed pretty full. The cro-k-ta I was not to impressed with and won't order again.

For around $8 a sandwich, and $2 an empanada. We got more than a full meal here for right around $20. Would definitely give this place a shot if you have not already.

Wow! Just had the Feta Spinach Salad,
I splurged and added chicken. I was worried the salad would need something else because most the time it's a bunch of greens and little else, I end up throwing away the greens.. Ummmmm but this was piled full! So good! Worth the $$$$.. Always Love eating here! If you want to eat FreshFood made daily with amazing ingredients and flavor combinations you will never go wrong with Pickles And Swiss! They have a Goleta Location as well.

This is by far my favorite Indian Buffet in the Santa Barbara area. I have tried them all but always come back here! The owner and staff are always so helpful and continuously fill water and clear empty plates...the best service every time! They are also the only Indian buffet in SB that brings you fresh hot naan for the table. Very clean inside and bathroom. Also located on state street so easy distance to shops. I always park at Ralph's grocery when I eat here. My only wish is if they could add saag to the buffet more often!
Great service. Yummy margs. I love the street corn and mushroom taco.

A little more expensive than I would like but the atmosphere is really nice. I ordered tacos and they were really flavorful. The one thing I didn't like about the food was that the tacos weren't doubled tortilla. My friends got the fries with her meal and they were awesome. Drinks were good too.

Rating 1 star because obviously I have to rate a star to leave a review. I mean come on, ok it's Taco Hell and not the best place to eat however is it that hard to get an order correct AND provide decent customer service!?  I know I'll post this and nothing will be done to fix anything since I've left bad reviews for this location before and we've boycotted for quite some time. This is our first time back in a long time. 

Just me luck that I get the bad experience on a day full of bad experiences lol. Exhausted from work and came here per my daughter idea since she's really the one in the family that prefers TB since we didn't feel like cooking. Drive through took forever as it always seems to do here. And I swear my only poor TB experiences are at THIS LOCATION!  Sat waiting at the window for our order for over 5 minutes!  It's hell getting in and out of this parking lot, get home and all in my comfy pants to enjoy our supposedly quick dinner......open my Mexican pizza and find very little meat (nothing new) I mean you pay $3 for it so yea sure I'll just take a refried bean pizza. My husband ordered the burrito supreme. Opens the wrapper and notices that it's a burrito but it's grilled on the top--the burrito supreme does not look like this. So he bites into it and notices just beef and lettuce, opens it and it only has beef and a little lettuce. Well, back to put on my jeans and off to TB to get our order fixed. Yup, took my Mexican pizza too because why should I have to e

We went at night and I thought they could use more lighting and more heat lamps for their patio. I had a chicken pesto panini which was very good but the chips that came with it had a weird seasoning on them that I did not like. My boyfriend has a cheese pizza which was also pretty good. I had a watermelon lime Italian soda which was so yummy and my boyfriends lemonade was also very yummy.

The most perfect, authentic, flavorful and fresh Vietnamese I've ever had out side of Saigon. The pork belly is melt in your mouth, and the Pho is delectable. The vegetables are always so fresh and crunchy. The vibe is upbeat, lively and cozy. It's my top lunch spot at all times!

this place is a zoo. Can't handle busy nights + people ordering takeouts. The staff are failing to cope. They tell you to come 40 minutes after ordering and then keep you waiting another 40 minutes!!!! Ridiculous. Avoid if you can.

I hate that the options in this terminal suck so much!  This place sucked LESS, and I wished we had come here first.  

I realize that doesn't sound like a compliment, but considering the nearby options, it is.  We were lucky to get good service.  Menu looked good enough that I was sorry we had spent money on calories elsewhere first. I enjoyed a nice Cabernet, but it was certainly more than I would normally spend.  Luckily Husband got a sparkly water instead of more expensive alcohol, which helped me enjoy my $17 glass of wine.  (same wine would have probably been $10-$13 elsewhere).

And the dessert Husband had was good as well.  Liked that there was a charging station for my phone at the side bar where we were seated.

If Saint Louis had a "hot, new" restaurant, this would be it. I have been hearing rave reviews about Indo for months now and I finally got to check it out this weekend!
We made a reservation and they are giving you a 1 hour and 45 minute time slot which is plenty of time!

What I ordered: I started with the air chrysalis to drink. I had never tried sake before and there were a lot of other flavors in the drink so I still am not quite sure what it tastes like. To eat I ordered the yellowtail nigiri. It has to be some of the best nigiri I've had in stl. Then I got the Japanese pumpkin. The flavor of the curry was amazingly smooth with just a little bit of spicy. (My picture of this dish is awful bc I guess I moved the phone before it was actually taken, but oh well hahaha.)

I am such a big fan of Indo! I know what everyone was raving about.

I had to use the restroom and casually chose this establishment. I was greeted by a brute of a man who asked me why I was there. I asked if I could use the restroom. He said it was not allowed and immediately began escorting me out the door. I showed zero resistance and stated it wasn't necessary for him to escort me in such a hastily manner. His response was that my presence was against the law. He was not kind nor friendly. I haven't been to Santa Barbara in a while, I guess I need to read up on the laws. Smh

My husband and I decided to stop here for a bite to eat and I'm sure glad we did. The food was really good. My husband had the atomic burger which he said was really good! I had the Pasta Bolognese and the Brussels sprouts which were both amazing. The customer service was by far the best part of our experience I would say. Amie was our waitress and she was very friendly and knowledgeable. We will definitely be back when we are in the area again.

Well I started my day off headed to My Favorite Muffin but when I got there there was a line to the door which is good for them :-). But it looked like it might be awhile so I decided to go down the road to Truckee bagel which didn't have a line to the door but had a few people waiting at tables. So I was patient and waited my turn after probably 15 minutes later other people were getting their smoothies and sandwiches that came in after me and all I ordered was two toasted Bagels with butter and cream cheese. When I inquired about the progress of my order the guy working behind the counter snap back at me saying they are doing things in order but I located my two Bagels just sitting on top of the toaster while they worked on sandwiches and other orders which came in after my order. the only reason I mentioned anything is because I didn't know how long they were going to sit there and it appeared to me they spaced them out. Yes they were very busy I was being patient waiting my turn but but when I inquired they were very rude back. The gentleman making the order was so mad he couldn't get the order Straight had to do another bagel which he did a half-assed job at because he was annoyed. And of course it didn't come out correct because I asked for it Double Toasted, it wasn't but I wasn't going to correct them again because he was already pissed off  pretty much  shoved my order to the counter and went on his way  and again was so mad he would forgot to give me the cream chees

I love hoagie house.  I've been a customer since the 70s.  I went there today, happy to still be supporting a local Tucson staple, and was so disappointed about the service.  The sandwiches we got were awesome, thankfully, but I don't understand how a presumably struggling business in these 'trying times' would hire someone who clearly did not give a sh-- about the customers.   When I called in to place my order, the phone rang at least 30 times.  I thought maybe they'd closed for good.  When someone finally did answer, clearly this person could not have cared less about providing good customer service.  In fact, it was clear that she was bothered by a customer.  I don't want to put down Hoagie House; they are the best.  Just watch out who you have as employees.  I want Hoagie House to stick around.

Love Sofia being in our Warehouse neighborhood. We dined here for the second time on a Friday night. The first visit was an event. Both times the food was outstanding. 

Friday we had the brassica and the meatballs for starters. Delicious!! The flavors were spot on! The braised lamb shank was so tender and the carrot purée was the perfect accompaniment. My husband had the bucatini Amatriciana and raves about the sauce and fennel sausage. Our server was warm, friendly and knowledgeable. No complaints so far. 

The restaurant is modern and lively with a great atmosphere. A bit loud but the vibe was uplifting UNTIL ..... at 9:00 pm the music was cranked up about 50% which made the customers talk even louder and made it impossible to talk across the table. 

Just saying ~ Sofia is a lovely restaurant. Are management/owners trying to align it with Barcadia, their other property? If so - BIG mistake. 

I would give Sofia 5+ stars for food and service, but because of the loud music I have to give it an overall 3.5/4.

What Point Breeze needed a good brewery!
Had the King Juice on-tap, which was great. To eat, I had the rotisserie chicken and broccoli rabe. Chicken was a lil on the basic side but the broccoli rabe was phenomenal. I'm sure this will become the local watering hole and a local fave. 
Will be interesting to see if it will bring people from other neighborhoods.

Great spot in SB for some seafood and views! Oh my goodness, I can't believe I haven't tried this place yet .. where have you been all my life!!? LOL. I  had a quick detour home from a weekend Solvang trip and my bf found this spot via yelp recommendations. I am so delighted to have stopped by here because their food is so bomb. I mean, seriously. I couldn't help but say that their entrees were delicious. We ordered the shrimp scampi, a bowl of new England clam chowder, and an order of fish and chips. To be honest, I absolutely loved their beer battered fish and chips! I cannot emphasize how light, flavorful, and tasty their fried fish batter was, not to mention, the fries were so crispy and fresh. We definitely had a big feast for 2 but I was definitely not complaining! 
For a Monday lunch rush, we waited about 45 minutes and I was able to take my little rsvp buzzer for a walk on the pathway by the beach. It wasn't too bad of a wait, and they did offer us a table inside (limited indoor seating due to Covid-19), but it was a really good experience. Our server (didn't quite get her name, sadly) was excellent and she made sure we were enjoying our meal. I would recommend this place to anyone who loves a good meal and view! The fish and chips are to die for!!

Went here for some friends birthday ( girls seem to love this restaurant)

Our waiter was very nice and I asked for a recommendation. I am basing this review on his friendliness ( made my friend feel at ease) and the dish he recommended. 

I forget the name but basically it was a pasta dish with a sweet fruit flavor on the inside. Omg. Never had a dish like this. It was quite the experience. Flavorful. Delicious.

We are visitors and found this spot had mixed reviews and wanted to try it out! Had a lot of good things and some things we didn't like as much.

Pros:
-Great value pricing and good portion sizes 
-awesome sauces 
-Good indoor/outdoor seating and parking available
-Fun, unique atmosphere
-Friendly staff 

Cons:
-Chicken burrito was pretty mediocre, the chicken was very dry. I will say, I don't like sour cream but if you do, that would help make it better. Needs a lot of their sauce to make it tasty.

So I'd fully recommend going for the tacos, those seem to get great reviews across the board, I don't think we made the best choice in getting our burritos.
From the service to the crab bisque to the prime rib to the cheesecake. This place was amazing! The pork chop was the best thing ever. Vernon was the best!

I had a cup of gumbo that was pretty bland. Also had a blackened shrimp Caesar Salad. Lettuce was very wilted like it was days old. I couldn't tell if there was any dressing on the salad, but I'm guessing lacking in flavor like everything else. Blackened Shrimp was also lacking in seasoning.

Had dinner there last evening staff could be better tables laid out socially distanced very comfortably. Food was good we all had burgers salads a great cheese board. Looking forward to going back soon
So underrated!! The sandwich I got was phenomenal, the sweet potato fries were great, and the waitress was super super sweet and helpful! Also, their happy hour is really good
Right in downtown Palm Harbor. Super friendly service. Tried the veggie roll and Happy Heart Beet smoothie. Both delicious! I recommend as a healthy alternative. Filling but I feel great.

I'm not usually one to eat at Mexican restaurants because I prefer authentic home cooked Mexican meals but I have a few friends that absolutely rave about how delicious Anna's Mexican Grill is. Well they were right. We called about 30 minutes before closing time and ordered a burrito, carnitas plate, an asada quesadilla and an horchata. The man taking our order was super helpful and kind! The food was delicious and so was the horchata. They actually were very kind and gave us a slice of their leche cake free of charge. We only tasted it and it was really good, but we were too stuffed to actually finish it. They give you pretty big portions to the point that you will likely have leftovers! I will definitely be back and will absolutely recommend it to friends and family.

I have driven past here a few times and finally came in, the building is for lease but the restaurant is open! I started with the samosa chat which was delicious, the best part of my meal. I also had malai kofta with garlic naan, both were very good and the portions were large. I'm glad I tried them.

Our second time driving all the way down to Brewerytown from Ft Wash and again soooooo worth it. Seriously how is everything so amazingly good and fresh?? Our family of five ordered the Spot Burger, a Chicken burger, a veggie burger, a cheesesteak, and two cheeseburgers. And lots of fries. Yes we r pigs. And we finished it all minus a few fries we saved for the dog. And since it's covid-19 season and everything would be cold if we took it home, we gobbled it all up in an in-car picnic w wine and beer. The place was hopping (meaning the phone was ringing nonstop) when we walked in w masks and all. So glad! Hope this place stays open always and forever!!! Wish it was closer but seriously worth the drive to get the best best burgers ever. Actually probably better for our waistlines that it's not too close!

How hard is it to listen to someone's request and fulfill it as a restaurant?.... 
3 out of 3 times I've given this location a chance over a 4 year period and they never get it right....

The macaroni and cheese bites, crab FF and the grilled shrimp were all delish. 
Beer of the month beer may be served in a yucky can.

Came for dinner on a Friday night and it was fantastic! Don't let the stars fool you, the food here is awesome and way underrated. Ordered the scallops with squid ink risotto and a creme fraiche that was all phenomenal. Hubs pastrami brined pork chop was unique, flavorful and a great meal. We also got the short rib egg rolls to start. Friendly service and we enjoyed the ambiance. Extra stars for being pet friendly and allowing pups to dine with us on the patio!

Simply delicious. Even during Covid this was a delicious place to stop and try a cafe au lait and some delicious NOLA beignets.  Touristy but a classic for a reason.  

The frozen cafe au lait is like a mocha milkshake and the hot chocolate was very rich and yummy.

Best place to kick off our trip. Discovering bottomless bloody marys made our night :) shrimp and grits plus gumbo hit the spot. Service was great our server Sunshine made us feel welcome and right at home!

They are always out of bagels no matter the time of day and the majority of the staff are not very friendly. The location hasnt had any updates or improvements in over 7 years. I was a die-hard Einstein Bagel person but the overall experience at this location forced me to start trying other places.

LET ME TELL YALL SOMETHING. I'm a true pizza connoisseur, like every other 24 year old I live off pizza. This pizza place, is now my favorite joint and life line. Me an friend found this place apartment hunting and we were not disappointed. The medium pizza we were bestowed was a heavenly mix of soft and crunchy crust goodness. The staff was so friendly and even gave us a few things to try. I will forever drive out of my way now to just to get my hands on some of these pizza rolls. If you don't believe me, try it for yourself. Keep it up slice! You have a forever customer.

Came for dessert and coffee which were both great. Got the banana foster which had a nice presentation and the chicory coffee was great too. I wish I got our servers name but he made the experience all the better

Let me just say my husband absolutely loves this place. It's on his way home from work and we usually order out on Friday's and if he is in the mood for a cheese steak he starts talking about this pls e on Monday lol. He loves their chicken steak with fried onions. He says they are so good he doesn't need cheese just the fried onions. They are served on a seeded bun which he also says is awesome. I ha e had their regular beef cheese steak and while it was good quality I ordered the one with cheese whiz which I wouldn't do again. Next time I want one I will try regular American cheese or provolone and I may even do the chicken cheese steak since he raves over it so much. Honestly I have never seen him get so excited over s sandwich. Give them a try the sandwiches are packed with meat and they smell really good too.

First time ordering from Jet's! I ordered online and opted for the small Greek salad with Greek dressing, Jet's bread with marinara sauce, and 8 corner pizza. When I picked up, the counter person was quick and had the order ready to go. I didn't check the order before I left the restaurant as the ticket on top marched my order. The drive home was 15 minutes. The Jet's bread was barely warm and the marinara sauce was refrigerator-cold. Salad was not Greek- it was some kind of tossed salad with cheddar cheese, mushroom, onion, and blue cheese dressing. Pizza was as ordered and I don't have any complaints about that. It's was fine. To-go orders must be checked and double checked, crew. To the person who got my Greek salad, let me know how it was! (Your salad was not good and the mushrooms were either canned or frozen, which was weird for a salad.) I didn't call to complain because I don't want to drive back for whatever remedy would be offered. We'll eat the pizza and chalk this up to a learning experience.

Party Fowl deserves an honorable mention for their wide menu featuring Nashville hot chicken dishes. I came on January 1st and the place had its doors open for many tired patrons who had been out all night and were desperate for food.
Honorable mentions: hot grit cakes with strawberry-jalapeño jam and the chicken poutine. I love the taste of grits but not always the consistency of the porridge, so this was a great modern twist I had never had with a good sweet jam to cut the dense cheese. The poutine itself might not meet poutine snob standards but I thought it was a unique twist with the Nashville chicken and large enough to share with a group. 

I split the fried chicken with gravy on mashed potatoes. Fair warning this is a heavy dish but I loved the flavor of the mashed potatoes and the combo of hot chicken balanced by the creamy gravy. Collard greens and mac and cheese were good. The gumbo was not super flavorful but still good. If you are picky or have high standards I would recommend sticking with the chicken dishes. For adult drinks, I tried the bourbon bushwacker. Some don't like the bourbon base but I thought it was still a nice icy beverage. 

Overall, a cool spot in Nashville and I hope to visit again and try out their brunch menu!
We love Lucky's it's right by my house. Meat is great. Vegetables and friuit can be on sale. Nice staff.
Terrible service. They take forever to get the order ready. Multiple poor experiences. They need to hire better people.

Very disappointed. I was told that this is the most authentic Chinese in the area. It was overpriced and not good. I know that this is where many Chinese people choose to eat in the area but the General Tso's chicken, egg roll, and crab Rangoon were all terrible. Also the manager or owner was very rude when I came in to pick up my food. I won't return.

This is really a good restaurant for italian dishes. The food is really good but I felt it is not that filling.May be I should try another dish here.  I am likely to go back again because I liked the location and the service.

Hello Vietnam is Pho-nominal. Do I need to review after that...guess so...or Pho. Okay, I'm done. This joint is on point during the pandemic. Has plenty of dine outside options as they added new tables, but their takeout is just as good. Ordered on a Friday evening and it took 30 minutes. Very kind gentleman over the Pho-ne and quick in person. 

What we snagged:
-Summer Rolls (SO fresh and tightly wrapped) 
-Soy Salomon Vermicelli Bowl (Dope, but salmon could have been less dry) 
-Shrimp Vermicelli Bowl (Amazing sauce) 

Overall, this joint is top notch. HUGE portions too. We have a meal for the next day. Bowls come with a spring roll that was VERY light and fresh. Highly recommend for a light summer meal. 110% will be back to dine in in September 8 in Philly or dine out during a cool summer evening.

I always see this pizza spot while I'm either walking or running.. I heard it was a must try and I finally got around to ordering. I ordered the small bbq chicken pizza. Within 3 days I was ordering it again! So good. Nice juicy chunks  of chicken, not too overloaded on bbq sauce, and each pizza comes with a serving of ranch, because Lord knows, I love to  dip my pizza in ranch   After trying the bbq chicken twice, I decided to give the spinach and artichoke pizza a go, I added chicken and mannn!!! Once again.. no disappointment.. I competed in the rock and roll 1/2 marathon so I decided let's try magazine pizza's pasta. I tried the lagniappe pasta, it had all my favs in it.  Shrimp, crawfish, and veggies but it lacked seasoning.. I found myself remixing it with garlic and Tony's.. but magazine pizzza, you have the pizza on lock!

Honestly, this bread co is the worst. Terrible customer service. I drove there and got a salad, when I got home and unpacked I realized they forgot my dressing. So I drive all the way back and they hand me the dressing, no bag, no gloves. They didn't even give me a cookie or a "sorry" they messed up my order. I'm livid. Moral of the story: they will get your order wrong, don't leave the drive thru until they fix it.

We wont return. This was not a good restaurant experience for us. The waitress was in a hurry and was very rushed. I ordered a gin martini and it was so sweet I couldn't drink it. The beet salad was drenched in salad dressing and un-edible. The lasagne was boring and mediocre. The trout was very good as was the tiramisu. I have been dining at Bria for many years but after this very disappointing experience, I will not return.

My first visit to this establishment and it did not disappoint. There was 6 of us for dinner and the host and waitress were more than accommodating. We ordered appetizers and a bottle of wine to start. Calamari with 2 different sauces to pair, Brussels sprouts and bread with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Dinner for me was lasagna with bolognese sauce. Absolutely delicious. And it was huge! With all the bread and appetizers I ate, I ended up taking the rest of my food home. Of course, I indulged in dessert, chocolate mousse cake. That was delicious as well, but a little plain in the presentation, but delicious nonetheless. All and all, it was a great dinner, we weren't rushed, and the waitress was attentive. I'd go back again.

Rollin' into great service!  So I cheated on my fav sushi spot Hanas for this.  This is a local fav, ask the insiders they know!  The decor is modern rustic with high private shiplap booths, a huge wrap around bar and tables for KBBQ table side.  There is also a patio with ambient lighting, but the shining light here is the service.  So attentive and multiple people checking on you.  The food comes out when it's ready, not together it's served fresh!  Ramen bowls, hibachi and sushi are the choices along with Asian fusion offerings.  The ramen is magnificent, worth it.  My only feedback would be the organization and freshness of the sushi.  I wish the flavors were better, and the sushi on the menu was organized by category.   That is my only complaint, this is a dynamite roll choice of a good time, try it.

We were out shopping and saw this beautiful spot, with a great keyboard player outside. The host sat us, nobody came over to say hello or offer us a drink for 15 minutes. I went inside to see if we could get service and one of the servers said, oh they must of sat themselves. Nope the host sat us and never told anyone! Downhill from here, dirty glasses of water, dirty wine glasses, my Pellagrino bottle was dirty and had no fizz left in the sparkle., the lines had no juice in them! We decided to not try the food!  Plus the server was miserable waiting on us, you would think after being quarantined with no job for months you could be happy and make your guest feel comfortable!
Good food and its a lil on pricey side but its delicious . Also it is very hot in the dining room as they got no AC in there. So don't go in middle of day when its the hottest.

Delicious, prototypical deli!  I loved the chopped liver, cheese blintzes, potato pancakes, and pastrami sandwich. The rugelach were dense and rich and, I think, combined cinnamon and chocolate at opposite ends. The deli was so kind, that they added gifts of apple cake. Rugekach, and chopped lumber to make up for the liver knish that they did not gave. How nice!  The prices are very reasonable. I had this grand dinner for Father's Day.  We will definitely order from Schlesinger's again and hope to eat in their premises when the pandemic has passed.
Wide variety of tacos and have not disappointed.  Easy to order online and pick up. Worth checking out.

I wish I could give it zero stars! I called for a take-out order at 6:00pm Saturday night and was informed they were not taking anymore to go orders. Mind you they close at 9:00 so it's 3 hours until close! It says order to go all over their website...when I asked why?!?! "The owner said not to" is all I got. We have spent a lot of money at this place, taken our out of town guests there numerous times, given gift cards to friends for Christmas to support local businesses...and the owner does not want to accept takeout orders in the middle of a stupid pandemic! I will never spend another penny here!

First time I went, loved their wings!! They tend to be a bit soggy & I don't like that which is why I don't frequent this place anymore. Their house dressings are great! I live their ranch fries. Service is always great & friendly!
Had a fun, delicious meal but they have no gluten free pastas (different than advertised) so just a warning!
Great spot for a late night vibe. Ask for JoJo if you want great service and some quality entertainment
They screwed up my pizza and then my wine that was supposed to be on happy hour was charged full price.
Pleased to say I had a pleasant experience. Thom Yum soup came out hot and tasty and fast.
